bciResProfileIntensiveDesc: Capacity and degradation analysis under high load.
bciResProfileCustomDesc: The user sets all load parameters.
bciResProfileUnlimitedDesc: Runs with no fixed request count, until a stop condition or user cancellation.
bciLoadShapeConstantDesc: Load is applied at a fixed target RPS.
bciLoadShapeStepDesc: Load rises in five discrete steps.
bciLoadShapeSpikeDesc: Applies a short burst of high load.
bciLoadShapeBurstDesc: Applies a dense burst of requests at the start of the round.
bciLoadShapeSustainedDesc: Applies continuous load at the selected RPS.
bciResStatusStable: The system remained stable under the selected load.
bciResStatusDegrading: Measurable performance degradation occurred under load.
bciResStatusSaturated: The system reached its capacity limit at the selected load level.
bciResStatusRecovered: The system returned to its measured baseline after the load.
bciResStatusRecoveryFailed: The system did not return to baseline within the observation window.
bciResStatusInconclusive: Not enough real measurements were produced for a definitive classification.
bciNucleiBundledNote: BCI bundled scope is preserved; dos/fuzz/intrusive/bruteforce classes are excluded.
bciSemgrepFullRepoNote: The entire repository working directory is analyzed.
bciResRecommendNote: BCI recommends; ADMIN selects. Selected values are never reduced by product policy.
bciUnlimitedRequestsNote: No fixed request limit. If Unlimited is selected, the actual Stop action goes to the scan-cancel API.
bciResModulesNote: BASE modules run automatically based on applicability. Your selections additionally run with USER provenance; AI can never remove a USER selection.
bciBaseModulesDynamicNote: BASE modules are dynamically selected based on runtime applicability.
bciInvalidPlanNote: INVALID_PLAN: Check positive values and the Ramp-Up + Ramp-Down ≤ Duration rule.
bciFuzzBaseGuaranteeNote: 🔒 BCI BASE guarantees at least {{count}} real tests on every applicable parameter. USER and AI are only added on top.
bciAuthProfileNote: Not a token; this is the BCI_AUTH_PROFILE_<ID> secret name. The same profile is resolved at discovery and execution.
bciFuzzCatalogSummary: Canonical catalog: {{count}} categories · BASE profile: {{profile}} · product cap: {{productCap}} · USER extra-probe cap: {{userCap}} · AI budget: {{aiBudget}}
bciFuzzRecommendationText: 🔒 Run the full BASE scope; suggest an AI_ADAPTIVE round afterward if the real results warrant it.
bciAiAdaptiveNotYetNote: AI_ADAPTIVE: 0 (cannot be applied before the first real result)
bciFuzzPreviewNote: This is a discovery preview; the real surface is rediscovered when the scan starts. Mutating endpoints are only recorded as HTTP_FUZZ_DISCOVERED_NOT_EXECUTED.
bciIntrusiveRecommendNote: BCI recommends; ADMIN selects. Only real IMPLEMENTED and applicable registry modules are sent to the intrusive-validation engine.
bciIntrusiveLoadingPlan: Loading real finding and registry plan…
bciFindingsCountNote: Real pipeline findings: {{count}}. Explicitly select a finding for reproducibility verification.
bciNoPriorFindingsNote: No prior real findings. Smart Intrusive BASE modules can still run independently.
bciIntrusiveRecWithFindings: {{count}} real findings selected; run applicable BASE verifications including FINDING_REPRODUCIBILITY.
bciIntrusiveRecNoFindings: Run all applicable BASE verifications on the real target.
bciAiCannotStartNote: AI can only suggest additional modules after the first real result, and can never start a scan on its own.
bciAdminExtraSelectionNote: ADMIN extra verification selection — AI can never delete or change this list.
bciIntrusiveModuleSummary: BCI BASE: {{base}} modules · USER: {{user}} modules · AI_ADAPTIVE: 0
bciModuleProvenanceNote: The same module selected at a different provenance layer is recorded as a separate real validation round. Live module progress data is not yet available.
bciCapabilitiesNotCovered: The selected engines do not cover all of the selected capabilities.
bciNoLiveMetricsNote: No live measurement data available. BCI only shows real measurements persisted by the engine.
bciNoLiveProbeNote: No live probe data available yet. No fake frontend progress is generated.
bciNoLiveModuleProgressNote: No live module progress data available yet. No fake percentage or counter is shown.
bciBaseUserUnchangedNote: BASE and USER remain unchanged; approved modules are only added as AI_ADAPTIVE.
bciIntrusiveRecRejectedNote: Recommendation rejected; no new intrusive validation was started.
bciFuzzBaseUnchangedNote: The BASE scope remains unchanged; approved entries are only added as AI_ADAPTIVE.
bciFuzzRecRejectedNote: Recommendation rejected; no new FUZZ round was started.
bciNewRoundConsentNote: A new round is only created with explicit user consent, and runs with AI_ADAPTIVE provenance.
bciResilienceRecRejectedNote: Recommendation rejected by the user; no new load test was started.
bciReportNoFindings: No verified findings in the executed scope.
bciRecommendationUnavailableNote: BCI recommendation unavailable; a safe default was selected from the available real providers.
bciCapabilitiesHeader: Capabilities — BCI recommends, the user selects
